dryad_delete_one: Observational sensitivity of a previously selected, already-opened30-story development cohort; no held-out or prospective claim.
One deletion measures local influence only. It does not establish generalization, causal effect, significance or a population confidence interval.
Story observations and mean human targets may share evaluators, topics and conditions; deletion does not model crossed-rater or cluster dependence.
The original100-story reduction followed partial model observation; selection and original unmet study/coverage/native-provenance gates remain unchanged.
No candidate, comparator or winner was selected or promoted. Historical account/model/receipt limitations remain.
poetry_scalar_order: Four selected synthetic families, shared artifacts and dependent cycle contrasts; not population reliability.
Unequal availability and tied score compression prevent arm-winner or equivalence claims.
Scalar-induced ordering is distinct from direct pairwise judgments and from literary correctness.
Creator variant roles provide no quality oracle; no human alignment, causal improvement or promotion established.
Historical report qualifications remain; no new current-account, sampler or native-runtime qualification.
ttcw_partial_rank: Inputs are saved JSON coefficients rounded by the earlier computation; high-precision arithmetic cannot restore lost precision. No raw-rank recomputation.
Post-hoc descriptive analysis; primary shared28 and dependent HBQ29 are selected available subsets, not independent replications.
Original shared33 rule remains unmet; seven/eight missing works, plot dependence and selection remain.
One control at a time; lexical length and raw TTR are related and are not jointly controlled. No nonlinear, latent or plot/condition confounding adjustment.
No causal explanation, significance test, confidence interval, human-validity gain or candidate promotion follows.
No adjusted competitor correlations are available here; unadjusted method points must not be compared as adjusted competitors.
ttcw_repeat: Two selected works; leaves and repeated question identities are dependent, not population replicates.
Post-hoc stratification and question recurrence add to prior unconditional equality/Jaccard summaries; no new preregistration.
Exact evidence-object turnover is not semantic reasoning turnover, validity, support quality or causality. A reference or summary edit makes an object unequal.
The one recurrently changed question is not by itself evidence of a general rubric defect.
Saved descriptor equality is not fresh native validation, current-account equivalence or sampler/backend attestation.

ttcw_partial_rank.formula: (r_XY-r_XZ*r_YZ)/sqrt((1-r_XZ^2)*(1-r_YZ^2)); X=HBQ ranks, Y=expert-mean ranks, Z=one control rank vector.
